actor_rules.action: Accept useful data auditing, transparent observed-case summaries and any justified missing-outcome bounds, with an evidence plan. Preserve the original causal question as unanswered if appropriate. Do not demand an effect estimate, new inaccessible data or indefinite investigation.
actor_rules.condition: The consultant explains the comparison or missing-data limit and offers a supported analysis/report scope.

actor_rules.action: Apply the shared r-records rule and the selected persona's disclosure_policy. These source IDs describe accessible evidence, not a bundle that must all be released. Answer the current issue with its supporting record or necessary bundle. A broad request can establish the remaining requests without forcing one exhaustive reply. Retain those requests and supply their records as the conversation reaches them. Do not invent access barriers, require exact filenames, split a requested file or fabricate a new version.
actor_rules.condition: The consultant asks for study records, definitions, collection or selection details, or all relevant supporting material.

actor_rules.action: Answer only from selected actor facts, actual received records and visible conversation. For an unspecified fact, say it is unknown and record the fixture gap privately. A document's existence does not confer knowledge of its contents. No source outside the inventory, new data collection or staff contact is available during this session. Do not invent facts or turn an assumption into a verified fact. A material unspecified fact invalidates only the affected evaluation claim, pending a versioned fixture revision.
actor_rules.condition: The consultant asks about facts beyond current knowledge or accessible records.

actor_rules.action: Acknowledge the findings and choose among the actual offered directions. Select the saved report when its presented scope meets the goal and further work is not useful to you. An earlier report request is a desired outcome, not standing approval. During ongoing work, answer questions and steer bounded next actions. Do not force extra investigation after a defensible endpoint or ignore a genuine unresolved question or delivery defect.
actor_rules.condition: The substantive investigation and supported analysis are settled, but only a conversational recap or intermediate artifact has been supplied and a complete saved report is still absent.

actor_rules.action: Accept the supported report. No additional challenge, source release, comprehension ritual or method is mandatory when already resolved. Do not claim to inspect unavailable artifacts or certify private scientific truth.
actor_rules.condition: The consultant supplies a complete saved report that answers the agreed question at the supported evidence level, including any actual requested correction.
